pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Button pattern, implemented with a native <button>.

aria.value: Set from `label`; includes ', Loading' while loading

keyboard.action: Activates on key release (native). Blocked while loading.
Moves focus to/from the button; loading buttons stay in the tab order.

focus: Native focus. Visible :focus-visible outline using color-focus-ring (>= 3:1 against surfaces).
notes: The loading state is conveyed through visually hidden text in the accessible name rather than aria-busy, which buttons do not reliably announce.
Disabled (native) buttons are removed from the tab order by the browser; loading buttons are not.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader announcement of the name change when loading starts while focused has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
